description: Official NBU rate for a SINGLE currency on one day. Pass `valcode` as an ISO-4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). `rate` is UAH per 1 unit of that currency. Omit `date` for today. For a time series of one currency across a date range, use `nbu_currency_history` instead.

date.description: Day to fetch, format YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240115". Omit for the latest/today.

name: nbu_currency_rate
title: Nbu Currency Rate
